summary: Rakuten Advertising says AI is changing how people research financial products before they click, and asks how to measure content that never gets the click.
eBay is waiving its commission on Live sales for invited US sellers until 29 October to get more of them livestreaming.
Best Buy launched Best Buy Gamers in beta, and The Home Depot is the retail partner for the first DIY CON in Dallas (6 to 8 November) with top DIY creators.
CJ and Rakuten were out in force at PI LIVE Europe, and Newegg closed a $100 million credit facility.
